claims: The Michigan Wolverines men's basketball team has won two NCAA National Championships in 1989 and 2026.
Under head coach Dusty May, the 2025-26 Michigan Wolverines men's basketball team finished a 37-3 season.
The 2025-26 Michigan Wolverines men's basketball team defeated UConn 69-63 in Indianapolis on April 6, 2026.
The 2025-26 national title was Michigan's first since defeating Seton Hall in 1989.
In the 1989 NCAA Tournament Championship, Michigan defeated Seton Hall 80-79 in overtime.
In the 2026 NCAA Tournament Championship, Michigan defeated UConn 69-63.
The Michigan Wolverines men's basketball team has reached the NCAA Final Four nine times.
The Michigan Wolverines men's basketball team finished as runners-up in the NCAA Final Four in 1965, 1976, 1992, 1993, 2013, and 2018.
The 1992 and 1993 Final Four appearances were vacated due to NCAA sanctions involving Chris Webber.
The Michigan Wolverines men's basketball team won Big Ten Regular Season Championships 16 times, most recently in 2021.
The Michigan Wolverines men's basketball team won Big Ten Tournament Championships 4 times, most recently in 2018.
The 2026 championship team was led by Elliot Cadeau.
Elliot Cadeau scored 19 points in the 2026 final game.
